content:
Overview

Otsu is a city in with a population of 345,000. A lakeside city on the shores of Lake Biwa, Japan’s largest lake, offering natural beauty and easy access to Kyoto. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
